_meta.purpose: Starter dataset for rawtocookedcalculator.com. Cooking yield % = cooked weight as a percentage of raw weight. Macros are per 100g RAW food, sourced/cross-referenced from USDA FoodData Central and USDA Table of Cooking Yields for Meat and Poultry, Release 2.
_meta.verification_needed: Spot-check every entry against live USDA FoodData Central (fdc.nal.usda.gov) before publishing, especially chicken (flagship page). Entries marked 'estimate' are not direct USDA cooking-yield data and should be flagged as such on the site, the same way Summer & Cinnamon discloses it for salmon/shrimp.
